annotations.title: Scam check for one crypto chat message (Telegram / Discord moderation, support inbox)

description: For community moderation bots and support desks: every link (known crypto-phishing domain list, brand look-alikes of ~90 wallets / exchanges / DeFi apps, homoglyph / punycode, typo-squats, free-hosting drainer pages, shorteners), scam scripts in English and Chinese (seed-phrase requests, fake support DMs, wallet "validation", fund recovery, giveaways, airdrop bait), and secrets the sender leaked (returned redacted). Returns allow / review / block, an action and a ready-to-post moderator reply in Chinese and English. PAID: $0.003 per call or 3 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/scam-message-check.

official_addresses.description: Optional: your official contract / treasury / deposit addresses, comma-separated (max 20). Addresses in the message that imitate them are flagged.

official_domains.description: Optional: your project's own domains, comma-separated (max 10). They are confirmed as official and look-alikes of them are flagged.

text.description: The chat message to check (max 4000 characters). "message" is accepted as an alias.

name: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams
